name: Falling Deep
source:
If you would like to play a LGBT friendly dating sim with mermaids this one is for you.

Come meet Theo (He/him), Darya (She/her) and Vesper (They/them), and get to choose between one of them, or all of them ;)

[From [url=https://kaoticlines.itch.io/falling-deep]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果你想玩一款LGBT友好的美人鱼约会模拟游戏，那么这款游戏非常适合你。

来见见Theo（他/他）、Darya（她/她）和Vesper（他们/他们），然后在其中一个或全部之间进行选择；）

[来自[url=https://kaoticlines.itch.io/falling-deep]itch.io[/url]]
